title: Global electricity generation more than doubled from 2000 to 2025
summary_raw: The world generated 31.8 trillion kilowatthours (kWh) of electricity in 2025, more than double the 15.1 trillion kWh generated in 2000, according to our recently updated International Energy Statistics data. This growth in global electricity generation is driven by increasing electricity demand from global population and economic growth, and an increase in global median household income.
